recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended unless a future work group decision requests broader editorial restructuring of the DomainResource introduction.
issue_request: FHIR-7456 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DomainResource correction from the DSTU1 ballot. It reported that the sentence "As an abstract resource, this resource never exists directly, only one of its descendent resources" was a fragment and unclear, and proposed clearer wording pointing readers to descendant resources.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 8e8c5b20b161b669967700dc213ac4e727eca143, matching the Jira comment that cited svn revision 6457. That commit changed the fragment to say DomainResource is never created directly and that one of its descendent resources is created instead. Later commit d8565d81844634c7138e99e85b3616945d2246f6 corrected the spelling from descendent to descendant without changing the meaning.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists DomainResource as an active abstract resource in the current build. The current source/domainresource/domainresource-introduction.xml sentence still conveys the approved clarification, and quoted Jira-key plus concept searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence that would change this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already fixes the unclear sentence fragment and no source edit is necessary.
